title: Independent reading: Luke 15:11–24
subtitle: Track narration, interior speech, and reconciliation.
overview: The prodigal-son scene moves from narrated action into interior speech and back into action. Mark the boundaries so the speaker of each clause remains clear.
Compare the son’s prepared speech with the father’s narrated response; the story’s movement is carried by this contrast.

items.grc: ἀναστὰς πορεύσομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ ἐρῶ αὐτῷ.
items.en: Having arisen, I will go to my father and I will say to him.

items.grc: ἔτι δὲ αὐτοῦ μακρὰν ἀπέχοντος εἶδεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη.
items.en: While he was still far away, his father saw him and was moved with compassion.
